reviews.title: Reliable CMR drive
reviews.comment: Copying a bunch of videos and photos (~300GB total) from my SSD on Windows 11 shows around 260 MB/s speed on average, though it's a somewhat variable. I wonder if the fluctuation is caused by Windows or the drive's internal RAM doing some caching to optimize speeds, but the overall speed is good at around 260MB/s. My drive showed very low usage upon inspecting its SMART metadata, having about only 24 hrs of power on time and a few power cycles, so it's very new. Great value especially given the rising SSD prices these days.
reviews.author: D. Lu

reviews.title: Great drive
reviews.comment: I was hesitant to purchase the 28TB Internal Hard Drive (renewed). I heard they were loud but its about the same as a regular hard drive. Sadly it was way cheaper last month but data centers drove up all the prices.

reviews.title: Great drives for a great price.
reviews.comment: Running great in my home server - 2 running in RAID 1. These hard drives are installed in 5.25" bays with 3.5 -> 5.25 converters. Running quiet and consume about 5-7W each. This item comes with the drive only and no mounting screws, so make sure to buy your own mounting hardware.
